import PyChrono as chrono
import PyChrono.Irrlicht as chronoirr
import PyChrono.SCM as chronosc
import PyChrono.SCM.Terrain as chronoterrain
import PyChrono.SCM.Mesh as chronomesh
import PyChrono.SCM.Tire as chronotire
import PyChrono.SCM.Driver as chronodriver

# Initialize PyChrono environment and core components
chrono.Init_ChronoEngine()

# Create a Chrono::Engine system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()

# Create an Irrlicht application
application = chronoirr.ChIrrApp(system, "HMMWV on SCM Terrain", chronoirr.Dim(800, 600))

# Create the HMMWV vehicle
vehicle = chronosc.ChHMMWV()
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.5))
vehicle.SetRot(chrono.ChQuaternionD(1, 0, 0, 0))

# Set up the rigid tire model
tire = chronotire.ChSCMTire()
tire.SetTireType(chronotire.ChSCMTire::RIGID)
vehicle.GetTire(0).SetTire(tire)
vehicle.GetTire(1).SetTire(tire)
vehicle.GetTire(2).SetTire(tire)
vehicle.GetTire(3).SetTire(tire)

# Add mesh visualization to vehicle components
visualization = chronomesh.ChTriangleMeshConnected()
visualization.LoadWavefrontMesh(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("vehicle/hmmwv/hmmwv.obj"))
visualization.Transform(chrono.ChMatrix33D(1), chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))
vehicle.AddAsset(visualization)

# Configure the SCM terrain
terrain = chronoterrain.ChSCMTerrain()
terrain.SetSoilParameters(1000, 20000, 0.3, 10, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01, 0.01,
